findings.message: The channel mode changes once, first from Stereo to Joint stereo at 0x19A.

1 frame reaches back further for main data than the decoder buffer of ISO/IEC 11172-3 allows, which holds one frame at the highest bitrate: the first at 0x18D7 has a main_data_begin of 485 bytes where at most 209 are allowed. LAME has not enforced this limit by default since 3.81, and decoders accept it.
